request.query: Polynomial substitution into any commutative algebra is a ring homomorphism preserving subtraction

      "informal_name": "Evaluation Preserves Subtraction of Polynomials",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} [inst : CommRing R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (x : A),\n  (Polynomial.aeval x) (p - q) = (Polynomial.aeval x) p - (Polynomial.aeval x) q",

      "informal_name": "Polynomial Evaluation Preserves Subtraction",

      "informal_description": "For any polynomials $p$, $q$, and $r$ over a ring $R$, the composition of the difference $p - q$ with $r$ equals the difference of the compositions $p \\circ r$ and $q \\circ r$. In symbols: $(p - q) \\circ r = p \\circ r - q \\circ r$.",

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} [inst : CommRing R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (x : A),
  (Polynomial.aeval x) (p - q) = (Polynomial.aeval x) p - (Polynomial.aeval x) q
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $ p, q \in R[X] $ and any element $ x $ in an $ R $-algebra $ A $, the evaluation of $ p - q $ at $ x $ satisfies $ \text{aeval}_x(p - q) = \text{aeval}_x(p) - \text{aeval}_x(q) $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Ring S] (f : R →+* S) {x : S},
  Polynomial.eval₂ f x (p - q) = Polynomial.eval₂ f x p - Polynomial.eval₂ f x q
items.informal_description: For any ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, element $ x \in S $, and polynomials $ p, q \in R[X] $, the evaluation of the polynomial difference $ p - q $ at $ x $ using $ f $ satisfies $ \text{eval}_2(f, x, p - q) = \text{eval}_2(f, x, p) - \text{eval}_2(f, x, q) $.

items.informal_name: Composition Distributes Over Subtraction in Polynomial Rings
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q r : Polynomial R}, (p - q).comp r = p.comp r - q.comp r
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $p$, $q$, and $r$ over a ring $R$, the composition of the difference $p - q$ with $r$ equals the difference of the compositions $p \circ r$ and $q \circ r$. In symbols: $(p - q) \circ r = p \circ r - q \circ r$.

items.informal_name: Scalar Evaluation of Polynomial Subtraction Equals Subtraction of Evaluations
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : Ring R] {S : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup S] [inst_2 : Pow S ℕ] [inst_3 : Module R S]
  (p q : Polynomial R) (x : S), (p - q).smeval x = p.smeval x - q.smeval x
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ over a ring $ R $, and any element $ x $ in an additive commutative group $ S $ equipped with an $ R $-module structure, the scalar evaluation of $ p - q $ at $ x $ is equal to the difference of the scalar evaluations of $ p $ and $ q $ at $ x $. Symbolically, $ (p - q)(x) = p(x) - q(x) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation Preserves Subtraction in Multivariate Polynomials
items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and ring $ S_1 $, and for any polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, the evaluation of $ p - q $ under coefficient map $ f : R \to S_1 $ and variable map $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $ satisfies $ (p - q).\text{eval}_2(f, g) = p.\text{eval}_2(f, g) - q.\text{eval}_2(f, g) $.
